scope: Manual full-body source-first claim inventory before opening current OnCo owner fields for this batch. Prior domain context is known; no blind or independent review claim.

requirements.requirement: Cytokines act outside the cell through membrane receptors; the cartoon does not show a cytokine entering DNA.
Receptor activation can initiate an intracellular relay and alter gene activity.
A generic drug-responsive engineered receptor can select signalling responses; the cartoon is not a proprietary receptor structure.
CAR target recognition and an added cytokine-receptor signalling role are distinct functions of different receptor proteins.
More signalling does not guarantee expansion, useful function or cancer clearance.
DNA, mRNA and receptor proteins are different objects; transcription and translation are separate steps.
Delivered mRNA is translated in the cytoplasm and need not enter or integrate into genomic DNA.
The depicted DNA route transcribes in the nucleus, exports mRNA and translates it outside the nucleus.
A CAR is a membrane-spanning protein, with an external antigen-binding region and an intracellular signalling region; the living cell is a different object.
CAR recognition of surface antigen can trigger a T-cell response, without guaranteeing target killing.
A newly made protein and the finished surface receptor are separate stages; a diagram connector is not a continuous protein cable.
RNA, DNA and an unspecified carrier cargo are not interchangeable labels; no integration or clinical effect is inferred from the schematic.
Reaching and entering tumour tissue is a separate barrier from antigen recognition.
Tumour cells may differ in target expression; adding T cells does not replace a missing target.
Suppressive signals and limited nutrients can restrict activity; persistence alone does not establish function.
Shared antigen on healthy tissue creates a separate on-target safety question; the conceptual journey is not patient-outcome evidence.
Ex vivo engineering collects cells, engineers and tests them outside the body, then returns the cells.
In vivo engineering delivers a carrier to cells in the body, without an ex vivo collection step.
Carrier targeting to the intended cell and CAR recognition of cancer antigen are different targeting jobs.
Both depicted routes require manufactured components; delivery does not itself establish treatment success.
An intended diagnostic use binds the assay, specimen, result rule and corresponding treatment/use.
A same-gene research result or a different analyte does not substitute for a label-defined companion diagnostic.
Drug A, gene M and assay T are fictional; no real pair or cutoff is asserted.
Fast track, breakthrough designation and priority review concern development/review support; they do not themselves grant approval.
Approval concerns a specified product and use; traditional and accelerated approval are distinct approval pathways.
Accelerated approval has benefit-confirmation requirements; the schematic does not certify an actual indication.
Expedited-program status does not guarantee approval, a fixed completion date, superiority or individual access.
Research-use status concerns intended purpose, whereas CLIA certification applies to a laboratory.
Product/use authorisation and laboratory certification attach to different objects, not successive rungs of a permission ladder.
An LDT is identified by laboratory development and use, not merely by an approval-status badge.
A status badge alone does not establish clinical utility, patient benefit or payer coverage.
A new individual-patient IND and an individual protocol under an existing active IND are different US non-emergency routes.
Receipt starts the new-IND clock, with route-specific conditional exceptions; this is not a promised treatment date.
Supply, consent and review remain separate readiness conditions; emergency provisions are not transferred to ordinary requests.
Epithelial, hybrid and more mesenchymal features are illustrative combinations, not proof that an observed cell transitioned.
Contact, shape and polarity are not a universal marker test, compulsory trajectory, metastatic route or resistance ranking.
Development and repair can also involve these properties; shape alone does not establish malignancy.
The schematic follows G1, S, G2 and M, with an optional G0 state and conditional return.
Relative DNA content rises through S to about double the depicted baseline before division; the late-mitotic sketch is a schematic state, not every instant of M.
A phase fraction is not a division rate and does not establish equal durations or a universal timetable.
DNA amount alone does not distinguish G0 from G1 or G2 from M.
Individual cell membranes and the extracellular basement membrane are different boundaries; the extracellular stroma is not drawn as naked free nuclei.
The conceptual stroma contains multiple cell types, matrix and a vessel.
RNA within a stromal cell can contribute to a mixed tissue measurement; RNA is not assigned exclusively to the epithelial cells.
This is generic normal lining, not a specific breast duct, malignancy test or invasion criterion; cell and vessel counts are schematic.
The fictional equal starts of1000 end at2000 untreated and1200 treated; net changes are1000 and200 and the endpoint difference is800.
An endpoint difference does not measure800 deaths; production and loss remain unmeasured.
Nondividing-cell vulnerability cannot be excluded by the cartoon; there is no regimen or patient-benefit conclusion.
Developmental ancestry, broad cell identity, genetic tumour-clone relationships and activity state are separate axes.
A fictional family or clone can contain cycling and noncycling states; labels alone are not permanent commitment.
An RNA cluster alone does not reconstruct ancestry or establish developmental direction.

noncreditDisposition: Palette, composition, font, dimensions, local paths, renderer/generator hashes and self-attested construction/review statements are custody or design instructions. They are recorded, not scientific or expert approval. Scientific guardrails and frozen learner-task quotes are retained as teaching requirements above.
bodyRole: All twenty contain substantive scientific or regulatory construction/guardrail text. Provenance-labelled bodies remain mixed/teaching-bearing; none is excluded as purely mechanical support.
